instruction: In my file system, add the prefix "YYYY-MM-DD_" to all file names in the ~/downloads/ directory, based on their creation dates, and then move all files not from this year to ~/trash/.

steps.code:
fs_password = next(p["password"] for p in passwords if p["account_name"] == "file_system")
login_result = apis.file_system.login(username='nan_ritt@gmail.com', password=fs_password)
print(login_result)
fs_token = login_result["access_token"]

from datetime import datetime
now = datetime.now()
current_year = now.year
print("Current date:", now, "| Current year:", current_year)

file_infos = []
for path in files:
    info = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=path)
    file_infos.append({
        "path": path,
        "created_at": info["created_at"],
    })
print(len(file_infos))
print(file_infos[:5])

test_file = file_infos[0]
date_prefix = test_file["created_at"][:10] + "_"
old_path = test_file["path"]
new_path = old_path.rsplit("/", 1)[0] + "/" + date_prefix + old_path.rsplit("/", 1)[1]
print(old_path, "->", new_path)
result = apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=fs_token, source_file_path=old_path, destination_file_path=new_path, retain_dates=True)
print(result)
check = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=new_path)
print(check["created_at"])

renamed = [(old_path, new_path)]  # already renamed
for info in file_infos[1:]:
    date_prefix = info["created_at"][:10] + "_"
    old_path = info["path"]
    new_path = old_path.rsplit("/", 1)[0] + "/" + date_prefix + old_path.rsplit("/", 1)[1]
    result = apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=fs_token, source_file_path=old_path, destination_file_path=new_path, retain_dates=True)
    if "error" in str(result).lower() or "failure" in str(result).lower():
        print("ERROR:", old_path, result)
    renamed.append((old_path, new_path))
print(len(renamed))
print(renamed[-3:])
